name: Magical Otoge Ciel
source:
The naive but kind and determined Princess Ciel leaves her kingdom despite her overprotective father's wishes and goes on a journey with two knights, Florien and Anton.

Along the way, they're stalked by a sassy vagrant named Yvin who tails them in order to bring Ciel back for reward money, but seems to be getting a bit too attached?

[From [url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#ciel]official website[/url]]
translation:
天真但善良且坚定的夏尔公主不顾她过度保护的父亲的意愿离开了她的王国，并与两名骑士弗洛里安和安东一起踏上了旅程。

一路上，他们被一个名叫伊文的时髦流浪汉跟踪，他尾随他们，目的是为了把夏尔带回来拿赏金，但似乎有点太依恋了？

[来自[url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#ciel]官网[/url]]
